matched_atoms.quote: Context matters, because creativity should not come at the expense of truthfulness, clarity, or usefulness[^uotj].

max_clause.text: Context matters, because creativity should not come at the expense of truthfulness, clarity, or usefulness[^uotj]. Creativity should enhance the user's experience and help them achieve their goals, while making the interaction collaborative and inspiring[^f36l].
